title: Card box
about: A box for a deck of playing cards, with rounded corners and a thumb notch in the front wall so you can pinch the cards out. The corners are rounded before the shell, so the inside corners come out round too; the notch is a circle on the front face, cut through the wall only.
picture_alt: An open box with rounded corners and a half-round notch in its front wall
